description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the NumberHelperService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains tests for number formatting functions, including number formatting and grouping with thousands separators.

classes.name: NumberHelperServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the NumberHelperService, verifying number formatting functionalities in various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the NumberHelperService instance before each test.

methods.name: testNumberFormat
methods.description: Tests the numberFormat method for various number string inputs and decimal precisions.

methods.name: testNumberFormatWithGroupedThousands
methods.description: Tests the numberFormatWithGroupedThousands method with different grouping characters and decimal places.
